title: A separating residue-field family gives a henselian coefficient section
statement: Let K and E be fields, and R a henselian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], all in one universe. Give E and R K-algebra structures and let rho:R -> E be a surjective K-algebra map whose kernel is the maximal ideal of R, so E is its residue field [def-weil-residue-field]. Let v:I -> E be an algebraically independent family over K [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis], and assume E is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] over the subfield K(v). Then there is a K-algebra map j:E -> R such that rho composed with j is the identity.

source.place: Proof, Local calculation in dimension d, first paragraph: lift a separating basis and its separable closure; second paragraph: subtract transcendence degrees

proof.text: Choose lifts u_i of the family v_i. If a nonzero polynomial P evaluated at u were a nonunit, its residue P(v) would vanish. Algebraic independence rules this out. Thus evaluation sends all nonzero polynomials to units and extends to the fraction field of K[T_i]. The algebraic-independent evaluation equivalence identifies this fraction field with L=K(v), giving j_L:L -> R whose reduction is the inclusion in E. This argument also handles the empty family.

Regard rho as an L-algebra map using j_L. A separable algebraic field extension E/L is ind-etale by IndEtale.of_isSeparable, so choose its filtered presentation by etale L-algebras. Identify the residue field at the maximal ideal of R with E via rho, and the residue field at the zero ideal of E with E. Their composite gives the prescribed residual embedding. The zero ideal of L is the pullback of both primes because field maps are injective. Apply the existing henselian-colimit lifting theorem to obtain an L-algebra map E -> R with this prescribed residual map.

Evaluate the prescribed residue-field equality on each element of E and transport through the residue-field identifications. It says rho(j(x))=x. Restrict scalars from L to K to obtain the asserted section.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_section_of_separating_family
    (K E R : Type u) [Field K] [Field E] [CommRing R] [HenselianLocalRing R]
    [Algebra K E] [Algebra K R]
    (ρ : R →ₐ[K] E) (hsurj : Function.Surjective ρ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker ρ.toRingHom = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (ι : Type u) (v : ι → E) (hv : AlgebraicIndependent K v)
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range v)) E] :
    ∃ j : E →ₐ[K] R, ρ.comp j = AlgHom.id K E
